items.title: Vanitha938/QADiag-ML: QADiag-ML is a quantum-inspired machine learning framework for early Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis using multimodal biomarkers. It integrates nonlinear feature mapping, matrix product state tensor networks, prototype-based kernel refinement, and adaptive gated fusion. The framework supports disease classification, longitudinal progression.
items.title_zh: Vanitha938/QADiag-ML ： QADiag-ML是一种量子启发的机器学习框架，用于使用多模式生物标志物进行早期阿尔茨海默病诊断。它集成了非线性特征映射、矩阵乘积状态张量网络、基于原型的核细化和自适应门控融合。该框架支持疾病分类、纵向进展。
